index.title: Envoys
index.description: Agents people can reach on chat platforms, each speaking through an account you connected.
index.emptyBody: To list an agent here, connect an account for it on a chat platform.

agent.missing: No connected account has <agent>{{agent}}</agent> as its agent.

unlinked.title: Connected, no agent
unlinked.description: Rome has access to these accounts, but no agent speaks through them yet.

change.delegateConfirm: Link <agent>{{to}}</agent> to {{account}}, your own account? <agent>{{to}}</agent> answers people in your personal chats on your behalf from now on.
change.switchConfirm: Switch {{account}} to <agent>{{to}}</agent>? <agent>{{to}}</agent> answers in every chat the account is in from now on.
change.delegateSwitchConfirm: Switch {{account}}, your own account, to <agent>{{to}}</agent>? <agent>{{to}}</agent> answers people in your personal chats on your behalf from now on.
change.unlinkConfirm: Unlink <agent>{{agent}}</agent> from {{account}}? The account stays connected, but its messages go unanswered until an agent is linked again.
change.delegateUnlinkConfirm: Unlink <agent>{{agent}}</agent> from {{account}}, your own account? <agent>{{agent}}</agent> stops answering in your personal chats for you.

disconnect.confirm: Disconnect {{account}}? Rome loses access to the account and stops answering in its chats. If you connect it again, it starts with no chats.
disconnect.delegateConfirm: Disconnect {{account}}, your own account? Rome loses access to it and stops answering in your personal chats for you.

connect.title: Connect an account
connect.description: Pick the agent that speaks through the new account. The platform comes next.
connect.anyNumber: An agent can speak through any number of accounts, on one platform or several.
connect.ownBody: People see <agent>{{agent}}</agent> as a member of its own, under the account's name.
connect.delegateBody: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers from your account. People see your name on its replies.
connect.taken: Already connected. Rome holds one of these accounts.
connect.onDescription: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers in every chat this account is in.
connect.delegateOnDescription: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers from your own account on your behalf. People in your chats see your name, not the agent's.
connect.unavailable: No new account can be connected on this platform.
connect.linkFailed: The account is connected, but linking {{agent}} to it failed. Link an agent under Connected, no agent.
connect.notFound: The account is connected, but Envoys could not find it to link {{agent}}. Check its agent in Envoys.
connect.linkFailedKept: The account is connected, but linking {{agent}} to it failed, and {{kept}} still answers on it. Change its agent in {{kept}}'s Settings.
